Thanks Elina — and welcome. Quick answers up front, then a couple of options depending on throughput and commitment:

Baseline list pricing (hosted API)
- Text generation (gpt-style, standard): $0.0025 / 1k tokens (prompt+completion)
- Embeddings (per 1k vector units): $0.0004 / 1k
- Requests under 1M tokens/mo: see on-demand above; bigger tiers below

EU data residency adders (hosted):
- Standard add-on: +12% surcharge on gross usage for requests routed to EU-hosted clusters (applied as a separate invoice line).
- Pass-through cloud costs (egress, specialized PKI HSM): billed separately when applicable — we can include a line-item estimate if you share expected egress/traffic patterns.

Discount & commitment highlights
- Volume tiers (monthly committed spend):
  * $0–19,999: list price (no commitment)
  * $20k–99,999: 7% discount off base usage
  * $100k+: 15% discount + eligibility for custom residency terms
- Residency adders are applied on the base usage line before the volume discount; however, we can negotiate that for larger commitments (we've made exceptions for enterprise pilots).

Options for Fintech Labs
1) On-demand + EU-hosting: Simple, EU adder applies; good for proof-of-concept.
2) Committed spend (12-month): We can rebate residency adder for first 3 months for commitments > $25k/mo.
3) Private/VPC deployment: one-time setup and infra costs; avoids hosted EU adder — we'll provide a TCO comparison if you want.

I've attached a SOC2 summary and a draft quote template. Rishi / Karthik — can you confirm the standard EU surcharge percentage and whether the adder is typically pre- or post-discount in our invoice system? Elina — if you can share target monthly usage (tokens and egress) I’ll convert this to a line-item quote and get a DocuSign sent.

Thanks,
